note: Compose mode pass 3 polish — tool maximize actually grows the chart (CSS lets the canvas escape its 90px cap when the wrap is maximized or fullscreened plus a post-maximize chart resize that clears the canvas width and height attributes so Chart.js redraws at the new size). Custom indicators are now promotable. They register dynamically into the compose registry on creation so the picker and the promote button work just like the built-ins. Two visual flourishes added. Three small luminos sprites in gold lavender and emerald drift across the chart area on slow sine paths and never block clicks. And a hover shimmer on sub-chart labels and compose pills using box-shadow lift and text-shadow on the label color so each indicator feels alive when the cursor passes over it.
